## Main locations

- code/ — six-stage pipeline, shared helpers, and tests
- code/stage-outputs/001-collect-ads-records/ — retained 76-MB compressed ADS snapshot
- data/analysis_manifest.json — frozen data contract
- data/analysis/ — yearly source tables and sensitivities
- data/validation/ — codebook and validation records
- figures/ — five main and five SI figure assets, alt text, and source manifest
- tables/ — auxiliary generated candidate-family ranking

Stages 002–006 have no external shared-assets dependency. The compact figure inputs are versioned, while the four large upstream parquet intermediates rebuild from the retained ADS archive.

## Analysis-to-file index

- corpus scope, cutoff, hashes, row counts, seed, and software versions — `data/analysis_manifest.json`
- publication volume, classification assignments, cross-listing, coverage, and class mapping — `data/analysis/paper_volume_yearly.csv`, `classification_assignment_yearly.csv`, `classification_crosslisting_yearly.csv`, `classification_coverage_*.csv`, and `arxiv_class_mapping.csv`
- primary-category audit — `data/validation/primary_category_validation.csv` and `primary_category_validation_summary.csv`
- tracked candidate families, field shares, log-ratios, and display threshold — `data/analysis/tracked_candidate_species.txt` and `candidate_field_yearly.csv`
- candidate-composition divergence, bootstrap intervals, period contrast, and specification checks — `candidate_divergence_yearly.csv`, `candidate_divergence_contrast.csv`, and `candidate_specification_sensitivity.csv`
- rarefaction, permutation, document-type sensitivity, and abstract coverage — `candidate_rarefaction_yearly.csv`, `candidate_permutation_yearly.csv`, `candidate_divergence_document_sensitivity.csv`, `candidate_document_type_flow.csv`, and `abstract_coverage_yearly.csv`
- lexical divergence and data-selected trajectories — `lexical_divergence_yearly.csv`, `unigram_yearly.parquet`, and the inspectable selection rules in `code/006b-build-si-assets-stepwise.R`
- figure-to-source mappings — `figures/figure_manifest.json`

## Network analyses

`network/run_pipeline.py` extracts occurrences and associations from canonical papers and candidate tags; `network/build_wimp_role_graphs.py` calculates field prominence, area-wide importance, cross-field betweenness, and node-removal sensitivities. `network/canonical-frozen.zip` and `network/wimp-role-networks-frozen.zip` retains the canonical event tables, metric tables, graph exports, and saved layouts. `network/summaries/` exposes the manuscript-cited trajectories without extraction. Historical run manifests retain their original input paths; packaged defaults resolve repository-relative inputs.

The network archives preserve the results and saved presentations used in the paper. Their historical manifests record earlier candidate-dictionary and network-code versions. The current code includes later revisions, so rerunning it is not guaranteed to reproduce those archived network results exactly. The archived tables, graphs, and figure assets remain available for inspection.
